12. Training: initialization, gradient, softmax stable, dropout, layer norm.
13. Variants: linear attention (exponential kernels), sparse, local, relative, multi-query/ grouped-query KV cache, FlashAttention.
14. Common pitfalls: zero padding, causal mask, dtype, scaling, head dimension, d_k, batch size, sequence length.
